verdict.rationale: Base44 docs describe a testing agent for functional/browser-based flow testing (base44-docs-44) but no dedicated security review or vulnerability-scanning feature before an app goes live. Community evidence even shows a security vulnerability was found post-launch by an external researcher rather than caught by any built-in security review (base44-comm-9, base44-comm-10, base44-comm-11), reinforcing the absence of this capability.
